name: Vanishing Buttons — Gola Monkey & Zero
competency: Understanding subtraction as removal/taking away, sequential decrementing, and discovering Zero (0) as 'none'
ncertStandard: Grade 1 Mathematics: Joyful Mathematics Chapter 3 (Vanishing Buttons & Concept of Zero)
overview: Gola monkey eats bananas in the garden. As his belly expands, buttons pop off his shirt one by one. Children observe the stepwise decrement (4-1=3, 3-1=2, 2-1=1) and identify 0 as the number representing 'no buttons left'.
learningOutcomes: Conceptualize subtraction as taking away objects from a set
Discover zero (0) as a legitimate cardinal number representing the empty set ('none')
Write and interpret subtraction statements (a - 1 = b, a - a = 0)

levels.name: Story of Gola Monkey
levels.description: Classic NCERT 4-button shirt with 1-by-1 button popping

levels.name: Subtraction Detective
levels.description: Deduce how many buttons popped off when given before and after counts
